trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no separate task behind it. Plan for roughly 200 hours in total (PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 difficulty): about 60-80 hours for the five story chapters, then the long 100% Completion grind, then stranger strands and cleanup. Nothing here needs multiplayer or DLC, and there are no online trophies at all.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first story trophy most players earn — just play through the intro as the game teaches it. It unlocks automatically when the mission's final cutscene ends. Nothing here can be missed, and there is no mission replay in GTA 6, but an opening mission needs no replay anyway.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and this pops at the chapter's closing scene. Do the optional side missions as they appear — several feed the 100% Completion checklist later, and progress you bank during the story already counts toward it. The one thing to protect in Chapter 1 is the first meditation spot (see Positive Mental Attitude), which PowerPyx flags as potentially missable.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete all of Chapter 2's story missions. By now the map has opened up, so between missions scan vehicles with the camera and study animals through the binoculars — the 100% checklist later wants 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, and every scan done now is one less to grind after the story. The trophy itself is automatic at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's mission chain. Keep an eye on the stranger missions (marked on the map as you meet new faces) — the Strangers & Freaks trophy needs 8 full strands, and strands started early are easier to finish before the finale. As with every chapter trophy, it unlocks on its own when the last mission of the chapter ends.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 — the last full chapter before the finale. Before you push into the final mission, check the Next-up planner: anything tied to story missions (character side missions, the meditation spots) is best wrapped up now, because GTA 6 has no mission replay and no New Game+. After the credits you keep free-roam, but story-locked moments do not come back.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold unlocks at the credits. It also opens the 100% Completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which is where the real platinum grind begins — most of the remaining trophies are checklist work, not story. Do not use cheats on the way here: guides agree cheats disable trophies, and they only unlock after the story anyway.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the Breakfast Run mission to its end. It is a story mission, so it unlocks automatically — no special objective, no extra condition. If it has not appeared yet, keep working through the chapter's mission chain; story missions unlock in order and this one cannot be skipped or missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission. Like the other mission trophies it pops on completion with no side objective to worry about. Heist missions are the big set-pieces of their chapters, so expect a longer mission with a setup and an escape — the trophy is awarded when the mission's end screen appears.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the Child's Play story mission. It is unmissable and automatic — play the mission through to its conclusion and the trophy follows. Mission trophies in GTA 6 have no gold-medal or time requirements, so there is no reason to replay or rush it; the game has no mission replay in any case.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. This is a story beat, so it unlocks by itself when the mission ends — the trophy is really a progress marker for the chapter it sits in. If you are tracking the story trophies, this is one of the twelve hidden story trophies (eleven bronze and one gold) that all unlock automatically.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown mission — the airport takedown set at Vice City International. It pops automatically on completion. Note the wordplay: this is a different trophy from the free-roam stunt 'Catch Me If You Can' (an unscheduled departure at the same airport), which you can chase later in free-roam.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. Automatic and unmissable, like every mission trophy. It sits late in the story, so by the time it pops you will be close to the finale — a good moment to check the roadmap tab and see which Stage 2 checklist items (stunts, challenges, scans) you have already banked along the way.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, which unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy and the bulk of the ~200-hour platinum, but the thresholds are lenient — it is closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, and 300 stunts. Progress made during the story already counts, so scan and study everything as you go. Work it in Stage 2 of the roadmap, after the credits.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered around Leonida — jumps, airtime, near-misses and the rest all count toward the same total. You do not need a specific stunt, just volume, and the game tracks them as you play. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy: another 50 and the checklist line is done too.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once each — the game's activities (races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, shooting range, drone races and the rest) each count the first time you play one. You do not need to win or finish well; just start one of each type. A quick tour of Vice City's leisure spots early in free-roam knocks most of it out in one session.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge is a short timed shooting drill at a range, and gold means beating its score threshold — repeat a challenge as often as you like until the gold lands, since challenges can be retried freely. Work through them weapon by weapon; the range keeps your best medal per challenge, so you can chip away across several visits.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race, so this is a tour: find a Top Fun spot, win its race, move to the next. Drone races are short and repeatable, so a loss costs nothing but a retry. The in-game map marks the locations once you have visited a Top Fun site.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need twenty distinct events, not twenty wins of the same one. Mix race types (street, off-road, boat, air) and work through the map's race markers; the Top Fun drone wins count toward their own trophy and can overlap with this list where a drone race is also a race event. Check the map after each win so you do not repeat one by accident.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival you meet while fishing in Leonida — take the challenge he offers and out-fish him. Fishing challenges are head-to-head catches, so pick a good spot, watch the bite timing, and retry the challenge if he wins the first round. This one is a fan favourite: it is also the most-earned of the rare trophies on Exophase so far.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game — any cabinet, any game, just play it to its end (or its game-over screen after a full run). Arcades are scattered around Vice City and the wider state; walk up, pay, and play. It pairs naturally with Master of None, since the arcade is one of the 9 activity types.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission chain through to his final mission. Andy is one of the side characters with a multi-mission strand: his missions appear as you meet him, and each one unlocks the next. Work them as they appear rather than leaving them all for the end, and the trophy pops when his last mission ends.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission, closing out his strand. Kenton's missions are boat-flavoured side work — take them when they appear on the map and follow the chain to its last job. Like the other character strands, it is not part of the 100% checklist, so it sits in Stage 3 cleanup after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand with his final mission. Billy's jobs come one at a time as you progress — do each when it appears so the strand stays ahead of the story's end. The trophy is the closer for his whole chain, not a single job, so if it has not popped, check the map for his next mission marker.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as map markers (the classic '?' encounters) — each one is a short chain of missions, and only a finished chain counts. Start strands early and finish them as their missions appear; PowerPyx puts this in the final cleanup stage, about 10 hours alongside the other character quests. It is not part of the 100% checklist, so do it after Stage 2.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Close out Randy's strand with his final mission. Randy's chain is one of the side-character strands that run alongside the story — his missions unlock in order, and the trophy only pops on the last one. If the strand seems stuck, check for his marker in a different part of the map; some strands move around the state between missions.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission to close his strand. Like Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy, Tyrone is a side character with a mission chain that pays off only at its end — do his jobs when they appear and the trophy follows. The five named character strands plus Strangers & Freaks are the heart of Stage 3 cleanup.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations across Leonida, with both Jason and Lucia. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: PowerPyx flags the first meditation spot as missable in Chapter 1 — do it the moment the game first offers meditation, before moving on. After that, meditate at every spot you pass; the spots are scenic overlooks and quiet places, and each one counts once per character where the spot requires both.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunt is a tracking job: follow his lead to the animal's territory, track it (binoculars help — studying animals also feeds the 100% checklist, which wants 100 of 255 studied), and take it down cleanly. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind spawns, so if the hunt goes wrong, back out and re-approach rather than scaring it off for good.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, houses, vehicles and out-of-the-way spots — and a set is only done when every card in it is found. Use the in-game collection tracker to see which sets are short which cards, and sweep one region at a time so you do not re-search the same streets twice.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo/tag interaction at landmarks and viewpoints — visit a spot, trigger it, and move on. It is a pure volume grind, so fold it into your exploration: every time you pass a new area for The Goodtime State, check for a WAiNK prompt before leaving. PowerPyx ranks it among the longest grinds in the set.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges are the small feats tracked under Progress — driving, combat, exploration and odd jobs — and you only need 50 of 80, so skip the hardest ones. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there: just play widely and it comes naturally, then mop up the easy remainder.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely. The partner matters: do it during a duo free-roam session (or a mission-free stretch where your partner is with you), get the heat up to four stars, then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars clear. Losing the level — not getting busted or wasted — is what counts.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — the chain breaks if the stars clear. Pick three shops close together, plan the route first, and keep moving: rob, get out, hit the next one while the heat is still on. A fast getaway car parked facing the road before the first robbery makes the chain far easier.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — driving or scanning new models as you meet them on the road. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 scanned, so treat this as the halfway mark: scan every new vehicle you see with the camera rather than just driving past it. Variety helps more than mileage — cruise different districts and vehicle types instead of one highway.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one activation of Combat Focus (the slow-mo aiming mode). Set it up where enemies cluster: a gang shootout or a police standoff with cover nearby. Trigger Combat Focus only once five targets are in view, and work fast — one activation, five downs. If the focus ends early, pull back and try again at the next fight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in a way the airport did not schedule — grab a plane and take off without clearance, or otherwise exit the airfield on your own terms. Any aircraft on the tarmac will do; get in, get airborne, and get clear of the runways. It is a free-roam stunt, so do it after the story when the airport is open to you.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhino tanks: this one is about tangling with the military's Rhinos. Get a wanted level high enough (or find a Rhino in the world) and survive the encounter — the trophy is tied to the tank, so expect heavy armour and heavy fire. Bring distance and explosives, and do not try it on foot in the open. Launch-era guides list the exact trigger as still being pinned down, so check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean, without any detection. Go in quiet: no alarms tripped, no staff or camera spotting you before you are out with the goods. Plan the entry, move when the floor is clear, and leave before the alarm state changes. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — slip out and try again rather than shooting your way out.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big robbery targets: crack the vault, grab the cash, and get clear of the response before the trophy counts it. Each vault counts only if you escape, so plan the getaway before the break-in — a fast car, a route out of the district, and no lingering at the scene.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around the state — intercept one, stop it (ramming or blocking works), crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat. The name nods to GTA V's Blitz Play, but the method is the same as any truck robbery: stop it, open it, vanish before the response boxes you in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. This is pure exploration: the map fills in as you travel, and an area counts once you have set foot (or wheels) in it. Sweep the state systematically — coast, swamps, suburbs and city — and use the map's uncovered patches to find the stragglers. Fold WAiNK It spots and meditation spots into the same trips to save hours later.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs run their own rackets around the state — find an operation, hit it, and move to the next gang's turf. The game tracks which gangs you have hit, so check your progress before repeating a gang you already robbed. Spread the hits out: robbing one gang's operation can stir up its territory.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a quiet moment trophy: go to Ocean Beach, find the bar or viewpoint the game means, order the cocktail and take in the view. The exact trigger is a specific seat or interaction at the beach — launch-era guides were still pinning it down, so check the cited guides for the confirmed spot before you go.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's front window — the classic GTA exit, glass and all. Pick a showroom, line a car up on its glass frontage, and floor it through. The trophy is about the exit, not the car, so any vehicle that can build speed on the approach works. Launch-era guides list the exact showroom as still being confirmed, so check the cited guides for the latest confirmed spot.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — and follow through properly. Head to the alley, start a game, and play it out; the trophy is about completing the bowling properly, not just starting it. It pairs with Master of None (bowling is one of the 9 activity types) and with Ten Pin, the melee drive-by, if you fancy the alley's car park afterwards.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership trophy with a mass-appeal twist — the description is deliberately vague, and this is one of the hidden trophies whose exact trigger launch-era guides were still mapping. It involves doing something notable together with your partner, in front of a crowd or for an audience. Check the cited guides for the confirmed method before you chase it; do not burn time guessing at the trigger.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this one. It is a volume trophy for the decisions you make across the game: dialogue choices, approach choices, and the small either/or moments that pile up over a playthrough. You cannot rush it in one sitting; it accumulates as you play, so just keep choosing and it lands in the late game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then pull it off the next time. The name says it: a first-attempt failure followed by a second-attempt success. Launch-era guides list this trophy's exact trigger as not yet known, so treat it as one to watch rather than chase: it will likely pop on its own during the long grind, and the cited guides are the place to check for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's oddity trophy. Leonida hides weird encounters (the name is a nod to the unexplained), and this pops when you stumble into one. It is an exploration reward, so the practical advice is to roam the state's odd corners — swamps, desert roads, late-night spots — and let it find you. Launch-era guides list the exact trigger as not yet known; check the cited guides for the confirmed sighting.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl the target over. You need a moving car, a melee weapon equipped, and a pedestrian in reach of the swing. Slow down just enough to land the hit, and aim for a lone target on a quiet street so you do not pick up a wanted level you do not want.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — dirty cash you cannot spend directly — and your contacts clean it for a cut. Keep robbing (banks, trucks, shops) to build the pile, then launder it in batches through the contact network. It is a long money grind, so fold it into the Maximum Withdrawal and Classic Blitz Play robberies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every dollar you spend in any shop counts — clothes, weapons, ammo, food, vehicle mods — so this builds itself over a full playthrough, especially once you start buying the 8 garage properties and kitting out cars. If it is the last one standing, buy high-value items you actually want (weapon upgrades, a good car) rather than junk.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are the property purchases that store your vehicle collection — each one costs money, so this is really a savings goal: bank your robbery and mission earnings instead of spending them, then buy the garages as you can afford them. It overlaps with Treat Yo Self, since garage purchases count toward the $100,000 spending total.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros is the in-game vehicle service — open the app on the phone, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until ten are on the books. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most; it pairs with Whip It Good, since the vehicles you discover are the ones you can register.
